 The above preamble/recitals shall be deemed to constitute an integral part of this Agreement which shall be construed accordingly. 
 
 Words importing the singular also include the plural and the masculine includes the feminine and vice versa, unless the context otherwise requires.

 SUB-LICENSE &amp; TERM OF SUB-LICENSE 
 
 The Licensee hereby grants to the Sub-Licensee , the right to occupy the Unit subject to the terms and condition of the License along with the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement ( “Sub-License” ), for a period of [ ● ] months commencing from [ ● ] and ending [ ● ] ( “Term” ) . 
 
 The rights under the Sub-Licence hereby granted to the Sub-Licensee shall be non-transferable and non- assignable. 
 
 The Sub-Licensee acknowledges that he/she only has the sub - license to occupy the Unit and this Sub - L icense does not create any form of tenancy. 
 
 All rights, titles and interests in respect of the Sub-Licence shall remain with the Licensee and nothing in this Agreement shall be construed so to permanently transfer any such rights, titles and interest. 
 
 
 SUBLICENSE FEE PAYMENT MECHANISM 
 
 4.1 The Sub - L icensee shall pay and timely deposit a monthly sub - licensing fee of PKR [•] (•) [Insert amount in numerical and words] (“ Monthly Sub -L icense Fee ”) against the Sub - L icense granted herein. 
 
 4.2 The Monthly Sub -L icense Fee shall be paid on monthly basis in advance of each month on and before 10th day of such month . 
 
 4. 3 The Sub-Licensee shall also submit a security deposit of PKR [•] [•] [Insert amount in numerical and words] (“ Security Deposit ”) against the Sub - L icense granted herein. The amount of Security Deposit shall act as a security for any damage caused to the Unit including the fixtures and fittings installed in the Unit as specified in Annexure B , default on payments of the Monthly Sub - L icense Fee and Service Charges by the Sub-Licensee. A copy of the cheque for Security Deposit and acknowledgement of receipt thereof are attached herewith as Annexure C . 
 
 4.4 Security Deposit shall not be adjusted as Monthly Sub -L icense Fee but shall be refunded to the Sub-Licensee at the time of expiry or termination of this Agreement, subject to deductions strictly limited and exclusively in relation to outstanding utility bills during the Term, outstanding Monthly Sub -L icense Fee , damage to the Unit (other than regular wear and tear). 
 4. 5 The Sub-Licensee shall pay, for and on behalf of the Licensee, to the Licensor the monthly service charges for the management, administration, maintenance and control of the Project , without limitation the Unit, common areas, common facilities and parking space (“ Service Charges ”) . The amount of Service Charges shall be paid by the Sub -L icense e as per the b uilding r ule s (“ Building Rules ”) specified in Annexure A .

For avoidance of doubt any change in the terms of the License shall be construed as a change in terms of the Sub -L icense granted herein.

 7. REPRESENTATIONS OF THE SUB-LICENSEE 
 
 The Sub-Licensee hereby represents that: 
 
 he has full legal capacity and power to enter into, exercise its rights and perform its obligations under this Agreement and carry on the business envisaged hereunder; 
 
 he will not utilize the Sub-Licence granted pursuant to this Agreement for any other purpose other than as contemplated hereunder. 
 
 
 8. TERMINATION 
 
 The Sub -L icense granted here in shall stand invalid and terminated in the event the License granted in favour of the Licensee is terminated by the Licensor at its discretion or in the event of default by the Licensee. 
 
 The Licensee, at its discretion or in the event of default on payment of Monthly Sub -L icense Fee or Service Charges shall have the authority to terminate this Agreement through a revocation notice. 
 
 Either Party may terminate this Agreement without any reason by giving 1 (one) months’ notice to the other Party. 
 
 Upon termination of this Agreement : 
 
 the Sub-Licensee shall quit and surrender the Unit in good condition subject to normal wear and tear; 
 
 the Sub-Licensee shall peacefully handover the vacant possession of the Unit to the Licensee or the Licensor, as the case maybe, within 30 (thirty) days ; and 
 
 The Licensee shall return the amount of Security Deposit or forfeit the same in the event of default on payment of Monthly Sub -L icense Fee , Service Charges , utilities or any damage caused to the Unit by the Sub - Licensee.

 MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS 
 
 
 10.1 SEVERABILITY 
 
 10.1.1 If any provision of this Agreement is held invalid or otherwise unenforceable, the enforceability of the remaining provisions shall not be impaired thereby. In such case, the Parties shall make every effort to replace the ineffective provision with a new provision which has the same effect, or as approximate an effect as possible as the said provision. 
 
 
 AMENDMENT 
 
 The Agreement may only be amended / modified in writing and signed by both Parties subject to approval from the Licensor . 
 
 
 ENTIRE AGREEMENT 
 
 The terms and conditions of this Agreement , the Agreement to Sell along with its annexures constitute the entire agreement between the Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersede any prior understandings, agreements or representations by or between the Parties, written or oral. There are no understandings, representations or warranties of any kind whatsoever which shall form an integral part hereof. 
 
 
 ASSIGNMENT 
 
 The Sub-Licensee may not assign its rights, obligations or liabilities to any party without the prior written consent of the Licensee. 
 
 
 GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION 
 
 10.6.1 This Agreement shall be construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan and the competent courts at Lahore shall have the exclusive jurisdiction to settle matters arising in respect of this Agreement. 
 
 COUNTERPARTS 
 
 This Agreement may be executed in 2 (two) counterparts and a copy to be held by each Party. This has the same effect as if the signatures or the counterparts were on a single copy of this Agreement.
